problem.text: Whether K_{5,5} minus C_10 and related twisted blow-ups of cycles are weakly norming; a convexity characterization of norming graphs.

claims.text: Theorem 1.3 and 1.4: C_k^bowtie, including K_{5,5} minus C_10 = C_5^bowtie and C_6 x K_2, is not weakly norming for k > 4; Theorem 1.5: weakly norming and norming are equivalent to convexity and strict convexity of t_H; K_{t,t} minus a perfect matching is not norming for t > 3.

assumptions.text: The polynomial P_{H,n} on step functions and its Hessian; Lemma 3.3's local structure of C_k^bowtie.

methods.text: Exhibit a 3 x 3 weighted host where a 2 x 2 Hessian block of P_{H,3} is not positive semidefinite.

limitations.text: Non-norming does not decide Sidorenko; the Sidorenko property of C_{2k+1}^bowtie for k >= 2 remains open, as the paper states.

relevance.text: Records the notorious open case K_{5,5} minus C_10, which this record identifies as the vertex-triangle incidence graph of the five-vertex Mobius band triangulation; the odd twisted blow-ups are the Mobius band family, open while the even ones (annuli) are Sidorenko.
